proof_payload.boundary: ERC-8274 recompute/cross-reference-console — claim_id independently re-derived from the live /ledger #236 source with reference/claim_id.py and checked against the registered ClaimPreimage; decision_ref taken as-is from the source, not re-derived from its own sub-preimage. Unlike node 2's v1 Cell this run was NOT inside the gateway container: dependency_lock, runtime_image and execution_witness are honestly null rather than carried over from a run that did have them. Envelope validity is outside this boundary and is established separately by EIP-712 signer recovery against the registered address.

recomputed.decision_ref_from: record.verdict.decision_ref in the live /ledger #236 source, taken as-is

evidence.cross_check: Node 1 (invinoveritas, verifier 54848) published a crc.cell.v2 Cell on this claim; this Cell is node 2's v2 upgrade, so the v2 edge rests on two GREEN Cells with byte-equal claim_id on distinct implementations (nostr/BIP-340 vs EIP-712, invinoveritas' own script vs reference/claim_id.py). Note the input content_hash recorded here will NOT equal node 1's for the same URL: /ledger/236 carries relay_anchor.checked_at, refreshed server-side on a slow cadence, so its bytes differ between fetches on different days while every claim-bearing field is immutable. The claim_id is the stable cross-node value; the input hash is provenance of this fetch only.

verify: gate the claim_preimage; recompute claim_id; recompute evidence_hash=keccak256(JCS(evidence)); recover the signer and check it equals signature.signer AND proof_payload.verifier AND the address registered in nodes.json (quadruple equality, CELL-v1.md §2); check registry_id equals this registry (CELL-v2.md §2); re-run the evidence yourself.
